requirements.title: Automatic conversation projection
requirements.description: When an eligible runner transcript is imported or an eligible message is appended, Agent Manager shall make the visible message searchable without making canonical event capture depend on semantic resources.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/projection_test.go::TestProjectionConvergesFromImportsAndAppends. Verify import and append projection, restart recovery, idempotent reconciliation, and semantic-resource independence.

requirements.title: Unknown-run text and regex discovery
requirements.description: When a caller supplies incomplete remembered text without a run identifier, Agent Manager shall return deterministic text matches and bounded expert-regex matches with stable cursor pagination.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/service_test.go::TestTextAndRegexSearchContract. Verify text ranking, phrase matching, structured filters, deterministic sorts, stable cursors, regex bounds, cancellation, and deadlines.

requirements.title: Semantic and hybrid retrieval
requirements.description: Where semantic resources are available, Agent Manager shall provide semantic and hybrid conversation retrieval with stable result identities and machine-readable rank evidence.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/hybrid_test.go::TestHybridSearchRanksLabelledConversation. Verify semantic retrieval, hybrid fusion, deterministic deduplication, and rank evidence on the labelled fixture corpus.

requirements.title: Truthful semantic degradation
requirements.description: If embedding or vector resources are unavailable, then Agent Manager shall keep lexical search usable and report the unavailable semantic leg as typed degradation rather than hiding partial results.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/degradation_test.go::TestLexicalSearchSurvivesSemanticOutage. Verify text and hybrid requests return lexical hits plus typed degradation while semantic resources are stopped.

requirements.title: Attributable hits and bounded context
requirements.description: When Agent Manager returns a conversation hit or bounded context, it shall identify the source run, message span, role, time, harness, source session, project scope, content class, and match evidence needed to interpret the result.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/service_test.go::TestSearchHitProvenanceAndContextBounds. Verify bounded snippets, safe highlights, context windows, source provenance, match explanations, and stable deep-link anchors.

requirements.title: Deletion-correct search
requirements.description: When a message is logically deleted or a run is purged, Agent Manager shall make its content undiscoverable through every direct and federated search path and keep it undiscoverable after reconciliation or restart.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/deletion_test.go::TestDeletionAndPurgeRemainUndiscoverable. Verify logical deletion, run purge, orphan removal, restart, reindex, and federated reads cannot rediscover removed content.

requirements.title: Privacy-safe content policy
requirements.description: If content is disallowed, evidence-only, oversized, or potentially executable markup, then Agent Manager shall apply one access and classification policy across direct and federated results and shall not emit raw queries or snippets in ordinary telemetry.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/privacy_test.go::TestSearchPrivacyAndContentPolicy. Verify authorization parity, content-class defaults, duplicate suppression, snippet limits, HTML safety, and privacy-safe telemetry.

requirements.title: Observable and recoverable index lifecycle
requirements.description: When an operator inspects or rebuilds conversation projections, Agent Manager shall report coverage, freshness, degradation, progress, cancellation, and recovery through dry-run-capable bounded controls without mutating canonical events.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/reindex_test.go::TestReindexLifecycleIsBoundedAndRecoverable. Verify status, dry-run planning, resumable shadow reindex, atomic promotion, rollback, cancellation, drift repair, and canonical-state preservation.

requirements.title: Direct conversation-search CLI
requirements.description: When an operator searches from the CLI, Agent Manager shall expose the typed search, context, status, and reindex operations without requiring prior run listing or client-side ranking.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: cli/domains/conversation/register_test.go::TestConversationCommandsExposeTypedContract. Verify CLI request mapping, JSON output, context lookup, status, reindex dry-run, errors, and unknown-run discovery.

requirements.title: Accessible server-backed Runs search
requirements.description: When an operator searches from the Runs UI, Agent Manager shall page server-ranked grouped hits, expose filters, provenance, match reasons, freshness and degradation, and deep-link keyboard-accessibly to the matched event.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: ui/src/pages/RunsPage.conversation-search.test.tsx. Verify server-backed pagination, grouped results, filters, safe snippets, degradation, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, responsive layout, and event deep links.

requirements.title: Authoritative Search Hub provider
requirements.description: When Search Hub routes an agent-work-history query, Agent Manager shall serve authoritative provider results and status with the same identities, access policy, provenance, degradation, and deep links as direct search.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/provider_test.go::TestSearchHubProviderContract. Verify provider registration, public search and status, protected controls, result mapping, direct eval, federated routing, and authorization parity.

requirements.title: Three-speed conversation-recall loop
requirements.description: When an agent must recall a conversation from incomplete clues, Agent Manager shall provide usage guidance, a bounded governed recall program, and evidence-driven improvement routing without creating another authoritative conversation store.

validation.notes: Planned evidence: api/internal/conversationsearch/capability_contract_test.go::TestConversationRecallCapabilityLayers. Verify skill guidance, typed program input and output, bounded complementary searches, deterministic merge and context retrieval, and improve-skill routing.
